verified_claims.text: Mechanism-level distinctness uses the CC-0020 AND-gate: auto-MERGE only when token Jaccard and embedding cosine both fire. AND-gate appendix: lexical fire without embedding fire is not enough for auto-MERGE.
Lexical Jaccard used alone is a string comparator and cannot be the distinctness rule for verified claims. Lexical-only appendix: a near-copy MERGE is string equality, not mechanism identity.
Embedding-only fire is ADJUDICATE not auto-MERGE so a high cosine alone never collapses a distinct unit. Embedding-only appendix: ADJUDICATE is a review cost, not an auto-collapse.
An auto-MERGE on a gold-distinct pair destroys a work unit; that over-merge is the fatal error direction. Over-merge appendix: destroying a unit cannot be undone by later review.
G-1 delivery requires live named probes to re-run exit 0 and a per-unit manifest sha256 match of the catalog output_path. Probe appendix: cloud ok true is outside this predicate.
Cloud ok equals true is not G-1 delivery and must not be treated as a completion predicate. Cloud appendix: a remote ledger tick is not a live probe.
A self-declared BLOCKED artifact fails G-1 even when the file exists and parses as JSON. Blocked appendix: existence is not success.
The catalog completion sentinel string must appear in the live artifact text or G-1 reports sentinel-absent. Sentinel appendix: the string is a substring check on the artifact bytes.
A claim record missing source_lineage must FAIL validation rather than warn. Lineage appendix: fail-closed is the negative control for RES-0001 consumers.

Every load-bearing claim must carry a Sherman-Kent confidence band from the closed almost-certain to remote set in the schema validation envelope. Kent appendix: almost-certain, probable, even, improbable, remote schema validation.
Each load-bearing claim needs two mechanically independent signals; repeating one probe is still one signal. Two-signal appendix: a second shell or a second field counts; a rerun does not.
Source lineage requires a resolved URL, a fetch timestamp, and a sha256 of the fetched bytes together. URL-ts appendix: path-only citations without sha256 are incomplete lineage.
